# Independent JPEG fixtures

Generated locally on 2026-10-28. No fixture was generated by the vendored decoder.

- `progressive.jpg`: the existing synthetic 512×512 `catalog-images/garment.jpg`
  transformed by `jpegtran -copy all -progressive`, with quantized coefficients
  preserved. Tool: libjpeg-turbo 3.2.0, build 20260630.
- `grayscale.jpg`: `cjpeg -grayscale -quality 90` applied to an 8×8 binary PPM
  whose RGB pixels are all `(37,131,211)`. Same libjpeg-turbo version. One JPEG
  component, independently verified by the native `file` utility.
- `cmyk.jpg`: native macOS `sips -s format jpeg` applied to an explicit 8×8
  uncompressed, chunky TIFF with PhotometricInterpretation 5, InkSet 1, four
  8-bit samples per pixel and pixel values `(0,127,255,17)`. The native `file`
  utility confirms four JPEG components and CMYK photometric metadata. This is
  an actual unsupported-color-mode input, not a forged SOF component count.

The tiny fixtures exercise decoder boundaries, not the product's 500-pixel
minimum side policy; that policy is checked before this helper is invoked.
